label: Whatever has the nine operates, from every intellectual PURE_ACT_5 being operating (inference)
rule: Restriction of a universal premise to a subclass of its antecedent: the sixth of the nine is pure act and the eighth is intellect
meaning: Strength order registration: every pure act with intellect operates, so whatever has the nine operates, since the nine include altogether immutability (by definition in potency in no respect) and intellect. Projection and application only; with the derivation above it gives the nine's operation from the three capacity premises.
